# The Fire Man

> The Fire Man is Andrew Knott's independent fire safety business for homes and commercial premises across Cambridgeshire. There is no shop and no street address on this website: the work is at the customer's premises. Call 07540 389424 or email info@thefireman.co.uk. Emergency fire alarm call-out is 24 hours a day, seven days a week. There is no long-term contract. Send a digital service certificate on completion of the service, and report any faults. Andrew has more than 25 years in fire protection. If a scheme membership is not stated on the website, it is not being claimed.

## Services

- [Fire Safety and Security Services in Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/services.html): Index of fire safety and security services from The Fire Man.
- [Fire Alarm Servicing in Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/fire-alarm-maintenance-BS5839.html): Fire alarm servicing and installation to BS 5839-1 and BS 5839-6.
- [Commercial Fire Alarm Servicing & Maintenance (BS 5839-1)](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/fire-alarm-maintenance-BS5839-part1.html): Commercial fire alarm servicing and installation to BS 5839-1:2025.
- [HMO & Domestic Fire Alarm Servicing (BS 5839-6)](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/fire-alarm-maintenance-BS5839-part6.html): HMO and domestic fire alarm servicing and installation to BS 5839-6:2019+A1:2020.
- [Fire Extinguisher Servicing & Supply in Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/fire-extinguishers.html): Fire extinguisher servicing and supply to BS 5306-3:2017.
- [Emergency Lighting Testing & Maintenance in Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/emergency-lighting.html): Emergency lighting testing and installation to BS 5266-1:2025.
- [Fire Risk Assessments in Cambridge & Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/risk-assessments.html): Fire risk assessments under the Fire Safety Order 2005, using PAS 79-1 and BS 9792:2025.
- [HMO Fire Safety for Cambridge and Cambridgeshire Landlords](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/hmo-fire-safety.html): HMO fire safety for landlords, against the Housing Act 2004, the management regulations and the LACORS guide.
- [Free Fire Safety Log Book (PDF Download)](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/logbook.html): A free paper fire log book, and NowLogIt online logs with a QR sticker on the fire panel.
- [Uniview CCTV Installation in Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/cctv-installation.html): Uniview CCTV installation for homes and small businesses, with viewing on a phone.
- [Ajax Wireless Alarm Installation in Cambridgeshire](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/ajax-alarm-installation.html): Ajax wireless intruder alarm installation, controlled from the app, with a panic button.
- [Monitoring](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/monitoring.html): NowLogIt Live, EMCS fire-alarm monitoring, and non-emergency Ajax owner alerts.

## Areas

The Fire Man covers Cambridgeshire, including Cambridge, Huntingdon, St Neots, Ely, St Ives, March and Wisbech, and the towns and villages between them. It also covers Newmarket and the surrounding area.

- [Areas we cover](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/areas-we-cover.html): the full list.
- [Fire Alarm, Extinguisher and Emergency Lighting Servicing in Cambridge](https://www.thefireman.co.uk/fire-safety-cambridge.html): Fire safety servicing in Cambridge, including schools, nurseries and gyms.
